ARCFYRE GSOC ALERT

WEST AFRICA FLASH ALERT

NIGERIA: HMPV HEALTH SURVEILLANCE - 08.01

The Federal Government of Nigeria starts surveillance at Lagos and Abuja international airports: Murtala Muhammed & Nnamdi Azikiwe, monitoring arrivals for Human Metapneumovirus symptoms.
